mixless beta.5 moves download audio processing into the app, adds single-model four-stem separation, and improves AutoMix phrase and stem transitions.

## Changes since beta.4

- Process downloaded AAC, Opus and transport-stream audio inside the Rust application with pinned, statically linked FFmpeg audio libraries. Installing ffmpeg or ffprobe is no longer required. AAC remuxing preserves the compressed audio; alternate formats convert to AAC. Website search and downloading still use yt-dlp and optional Deno.
- Stop retrying unavailable download tools and keep repeated download errors concise. Preserve recording titles, artists and ISRC tags, with configurable download filenames.
- Separate vocals, drums, bass and other instruments together with one BS-RoFormer model. Cache stems by audio content so metadata-only edits can reuse them. Existing analyses refresh for the current model.
- Improve AutoMix phrase release, vocal overlap, rhythmic alignment, sounding-key matching and pitch restoration. Show the actual transition phase and stem exchange in the preview, and persist prepared best orders.
- Add independent MIDI and HID controller presets, community adapters, direct mapping controls and offline NI MIDI compatibility. Preserve cue pad colors on hover.
- Keep MLX-first inference on compatible Apple Silicon Macs, with CPU handling unsupported operations and runtime fallback. The current BS-RoFormer and Basic Pitch graphs bypass CoreML. Intel Macs can play cached stems but cannot generate model analyses.

## Install or update

The app and installers are universal macOS builds, Developer ID signed, Apple notarized and stapled. Open a DMG and drag mixless to Applications, or double-click the app to install. Existing beta users can choose **mixless → Check for Updates…**, then restart when prompted. Both installer variants use the same library and updates preserve the installed variant.

`SHA256SUMS.txt` verifies both installers. `mixless-beta-latest.json` supplies the beta updater feed. Each application contains FFmpeg license notices, corresponding source and rebuild instructions.

## Beta limitations

Stem separation and AutoMix remain estimates; audition unfamiliar transitions. Automated signal checks do not establish subjective listening quality. MLX may delegate unsupported operators to CPU, and an unavailable or failed accelerated backend falls back to CPU. First-use model loading and compilation are separate from repeated inference time.

Spotify supplies playlist metadata. Audio availability depends on the local library or download service, and imported audio remains subject to its own rights.
